message.content:
This editorial illustration features an orange background containing multiple dark, oval-shaped holes. A man with a yellow-toned face, a balding head with dark hair on the sides, and wide eyes emerges from one hole. He has white teardrop shapes on his forehead and holds his hands up with palms facing outward. To the right, a hand in a black sleeve with a yellow cuff grips a brown wooden gavel. The gavel appears to strike the surface between two holes, where two white puff clouds are visible. A vertical beam composed of white dots descends from the top toward the gavel.

The top of the image contains the large white word "TEMPO" followed by "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Headlines in white text include "CEKI-CEKI BUDI ARIE," "Perseturuan Dokter-Menteri Kesehatan Masuk Istana H.30," and "Kepentingan Politik Badan Penerimaan Negara H.76." A block of white text describes defendants in an "online" gambling case. The top right corner includes a barcode, a QR code, a "51" logo, and text indicating "30 JUNI-6 JULI 2025" and "RP 60.000."
